title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1rnj: missed third &bitmap -> bitmap at line 1280
description: The diff in fragment.rs changed two of three Ack::new call sites from &bitmap to bitmap (lines 1237, 1252), but missed the third at line 1280 in the success path of finalize(). Ack::new takes u64, not &u64, so this is a compile error. Fix: change &bitmap to bitmap at line 1280.
